STEP 6. Check the rear washer motor connector A-34 for 
damage.
Q: Is rear washer motor connector A-34 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The rear washer 
should work normally.
STEP 7. Check the harness wire between rear washer 
motor connector A-34 and ground.
Q: Is the harness wire between rear washer motor 
connector A-34 and ground in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair it. The rear washer should work normally.
STEP 8. Check the rear washer motor connector A-34 and 
ETACS-ECU connector C-114 for damage.
Q: Are rear washer motor connector A-34 and ETACS-ECU 
connector C-114 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 9.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The rear 
washer should work normally.
